blocks.text: Aap jante hain ke cell ke teen bare hisse hain: plasma membrane, cytoplasm aur nucleus. Cytoplasm ek semi-viscous (thora gaarha) aur semi-transparent (thora aar-paar dikhne wala) madda hai. Eukaryotic cells mein yeh plasma membrane aur nuclear envelope ke darmiyan hota hai. Prokaryotic cells mein yeh plasma membrane ke neeche ki saari jagah bharta hai. Is ka bunyadi pani wala madda cytosol kehlata hai, jis mein organelles aur doosri cheezen hoti hain. Cytosol mein pani hai jis mein bohat se organic madde (proteins, carbohydrates, lipids) aur inorganic salts poori ya kuch had tak ghule hote hain. Cytoplasm organelles ko theek kaam karne ki jagah deta hai aur kai biochemical (metabolic) reactions ki jagah bhi hai, misal ke taur par glycolysis (aerobic respiration mein glucose ka tootna).

Cytoplasm mein alag alag structures hoti hain jo cell ke khaas kaamon ke liye hain; inhen cell organelles kehte hain. Ribosome jaise chand organelles ke ilawa aam taur par organelles membrane mein band hote hain. Agle paragraphs mein aham organelles ki banawat aur kaam bayan kiye gaye hain.

blocks.alt: Poday ka cell jo plasmodesmata wali cell wall aur plasma membrane mein band hai. Andar cytoplasm, bari vacuole, chloroplasts, mitochondria, peroxisome, Golgi vesicles ke saath Golgi apparatus, rough aur smooth endoplasmic reticulum, ribosomes, cytoskeleton ke fibres, aur nucleus apni nuclear envelope, nuclear pores aur nucleolus ke saath hai.

blocks.alt: Janwar ka cell jo sirf plasma membrane mein band hai, cell wall nahin. Cytoplasm mein nuclear envelope, nuclear pores aur nucleolus wala nucleus, rough aur smooth endoplasmic reticulum, Golgi apparatus, mitochondria, peroxisome, lysosome, ribosomes, cytoskeleton ke fibres, centrosome (seedhe zaviye par do centrioles) aur ek secretory vesicle hai.

blocks.text: Dono figures (3.9 aur 3.10) ka muqabla karein: poday ke cell mein cell wall, chloroplasts aur bari central vacuole hai; janwar ke cell mein yeh nahin, magar centrosome (centrioles ka jora) aur lysosomes hain.
